remarks: New Construction for Rent! This historical dwelling, built in 2024, has been meticulously reconstructed, blending classic and modern designs. Explore the luxury and comfort of a three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom haven, complete with an open floor plan and large windows that radiate warmth and light. Enjoy the refined charm of elegant hardwood floors as you navigate the expansive living area. For culinary enthusiasts, the kitchen is a haven of modernity, packed with modern appliances, abundant storage, and dazzling quartz countertops. This contemporary design boasts energy-efficient features like LED lights, double-glazed windows, and spray foam insulation. Nestled in the lively heart of Stamford, everything you need is at your fingertips. From fantastic restaurants and cafes to shopping centers, recreational facilities, beaches, and nearby Harbor Point, it's perfect for those seeking a luxurious living experience. Plus, within minutes from Stamford's Amtrak/Metro Train Station, it will whisk you to NYC in 55 minutes.
